validity.recommendation: Set Operator to 'Texas Eastern Transmission, LP' (the entity that Enbridge's own project page and fact sheet state will construct, own, and operate the meter/regulating facilities); flag the EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook's 'Operator' field for this exact project (row 1088 of the Aug2026 Historical Projects sheet), which instead reads 'Venture Global Gator Express LLC'.
validity.researcher_notes: Existence, classification and duplicate status are all clean. The project is real and independently documented: Enbridge's own 'Gator Express Meter Project' page (archived) and its June-2022 fact sheet both describe exactly this scope -- new metering/regulating (M&R) facilities and about 0.2 mile of 30-inch interconnection piping from Texas Eastern's Line 40 to Venture Global's Gator Express platform, 240,000 Dth/d, Docket CP22-43 -- and EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook independently tracks the identical project under the identical docket (CP22-43) from its first appearance (Jan-2022 release, 'Applied', filed 2022-01-28) through completion (Apr-2024 release onward, 'Completed', in-service 2023-08-25). It is NOT a duplicate of the physically separate P0193/P3193 Gator Express Phase 1/2 lateral (Venture Global's own 12-42 mi, 42-inch pipe to the LNG terminal) -- P3193's own shard (this same batch) independently reached the same conclusion and named P5415 in its cross_row_leads as Texas Eastern/Enbridge's own interconnection facilities at the tie-in point, not part of Venture Global's lateral. PipelineType='transmission' is reasonable: this is FERC-jurisdictional, interstate-classified (per EIA) pipe tying into Texas Eastern Transmission's interstate mainline, not a gathering line. One real ambiguity: WHO is the operator. Enbridge's page states 'Texas Eastern Transmission, LP ("Texas Eastern") proposes to construct, own and operate new metering and regulating facilities ...', and separately lists 'Ownership: Enbridge Inc. (100%)' -- consistent with the sheet's existing Owner1 (Enbridge, 100%). But EIA's own project database attributes the SAME docket (CP22-43) to operator 'Venture Global Gator Express LLC', not Texas Eastern. Both the project webpage and its own fact sheet (same origin, Texas Eastern/Enbridge) independently and repeatedly describe Texas Eastern as the builder/owner/operator of these specific M&R facilities and the interconnection piping, which is the more specific and on-point disclosure; EIA's operator field most likely reflects EIA's convention of grouping all 'Gator Express'-titled projects under the LNG sponsor's project family rather than a conflicting factual claim. Flagging as attribution caveat rather than overwriting the EIA figure silently.
